scope: Functional evidence only. Hosted verification is left to the operator acceptance task. No VM or SSH access was used and no operator key was read. This is the second line of defence; the source fix is BFF-EVO-JOURNAL-VERSION-STRING-20261126.
root_cause: src/management/pages/oversight/_core.tsx (EvolutionJournalPage row render, previously line ~4508) did `e.target.version.toLowerCase()`, and likewise for target.type, target.id, title/mutation/id, status/verdict, action_type and risk_level, plus `e.persona_name?.trim()`. Before the BFF source fix, the aggregate emitted pool_version rows with `target={"type": "persona", "id": persona_id, "version": <int>}` (services/control-plane/bff/evolution/service.py evolution_journal_pool_version_items) and decision rows passed the stored target_version through unchanged, so a number reached the renderer and the whole page fell into the error boundary. The numeric version was computed before the pool_version branch, so pool_version rows crashed too.

change.evolutionJournalFocus.ts: New exported helpers journalFieldText(value) (string as is; finite number, boolean or bigint as String(value); anything else '') and cleanJournalFieldText(value) (the same, minus the literal nan/undefined/null placeholders, matching the previous filter exactly). evolutionEntryText (focus filtering) reads target.type/id/version through journalFieldText. EvolutionJournalEntry.target fields widened to string | number | null.
change._core.tsx: headline, status, action, risk, cleanTargetType/Id/Version use cleanJournalFieldText; both persona_name reads use journalFieldText(...).trim(). EvolutionEntry.target fields widened to string | number | null. Behaviour for string values is unchanged (same placeholder list, no trimming added, same fallbacks to undefined/'').

acceptance.1: _core.tsx and evolutionJournalFocus.ts convert target.version and every other journal field they call a string method on (target.type, target.id, title/mutation/id, status/verdict, action_type, risk_level, persona_name) to text before use. Numeric version renders as text ('candidate_artifact:plan-num-1-execution-artifact (3)'); null and missing versions render the target without a suffix; nothing throws.
